top_issues: Town and tenure inconsistencies (New Brunswick vs South Brunswick vs East Brunswick; 45 vs 40 years) confuse both customers and local search
Contact form fields have no labels (placeholders only) and the form is protected by Cloudflare Turnstile, which can stop agent-assisted submissions
No LocalBusiness/TreeService schema with hours, service area and services; no online estimate booking for quote-heavy tree work

agent_readiness.notes: robots.txt is wide open (User-agent: *, empty Disallow), so AI crawlers are welcome. Services, service areas and tenure are readable text, and the phone number is prominent. JSON-LD exists as a graph but only WebPage/WebSite/Organization types - no LocalBusiness, no opening hours, no price ranges. The CF7 form has a service dropdown but placeholder-only labels and a Cloudflare Turnstile token, so an automated agent cannot reliably submit it; there is no calendar.

operations_signals.signal: Emergency tree service and storm work imply after-hours calls that a single office line must absorb
All estimates are 'free estimate - call', with no photo upload or measuring intake even though tree jobs need a site assessment
274-280 Google reviews at 4.9 indicate a high job volume relative to office staff
